label: batch-15
tail:
Batch 15 authoring is complete for five new items. The published A-page carriers remain unchanged.

- The A page adds a candidate antipode definition and a proof that it descends and satisfies both antipode identities.
- The B page adds the full 13-case braid table, an \(N=2\) quantum–Hecke commutation calculation, and the \(N=1,n=2\) nonfaithfulness counterexample.
- The five items have current Step-1 `ready` records. The [A page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/hecke-symmetries-and-generic-quantum-schur-weyl-duality.md), [B page](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/hopf-hecke-algebras/hecke-symmetries-and-generic-quantum-schur-weyl-duality-examples.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-15.pages.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-15.proof-contracts.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-15.coverage.json), [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-15.cross-batch-dependencies.json), and [notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/hopf-hecke-unfinished-15-2026-10-15-batch-15.notes.md) record the work and handoff.

Scoped checks passed: precheck, rendercheck, proof contracts, proof layout (5 items, 16 steps, 0 defects), content policy, dependency checks, coverage checklist, and source fetch (2/2). I read the relevant full sections in [Etingof–Semenyakin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.05252) and [Luo–Wang](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.07203).

Four declared page prerequisites—batches 3, 5, 8, and 11—remain open because their supplier pages have empty inventories; exact supplier IDs and hypotheses are recorded. A run-wide dependency-level recomputation was also blocked by an invalid `\l` YAML escape in the separate draft item [thm-hh-affine-type-a-bernstein-pbw.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-hh-affine-type-a-bernstein-pbw.md:21). I left that out-of-batch item unchanged.
